entries.name: 01-medium-frayed
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image1 is the blank lightened modal paper EDIT TARGET; image2 is the accepted more-torn paper STYLE reference. Create ONE new blank reusable game UI paper panel, isolated with real alpha transparency outside. Match the exact very pale creamy near-white color, subtle soft paper fibres, thickness and gentle material shading of image1. Preserve a tall portrait rounded rectangle, front-on orthographic, straight vertical orientation, entire silhouette visible with narrow transparent margin. Broad calm intact light center reserved for text, at least central70percent width. Change only edge wear and a few localized shallow crumple creases. No text,numbers,icons,buttons,X,UI,characters,watermarks,black lines,brown outlines,dirty stains,yellow/orange tint,scene background,checkerboard pixels,exterior cast shadow or glow. No folded-over,rolled or curled corners. Tears are real irregular missing-paper notches/narrow inward slits with softly frayed fibres and delicate natural relief, not a regular serrated pattern. Paper stays one intact continuous sheet. Preserve current pale finish; do not darken to aged parchment. Output exactly one transparent PNG paper candidate. Variant A: medium wear. Approximately12small-to-medium organically spaced edge nicks and V-shaped paper tears across all4edges, asymmetrically distributed, with3more noticeable short tears of2–3percent panel width. Gently rubbed rounded corners. Add2localized shallow crumpled ripple patches near upper-left edge and lower-right edge; faint,soft and physical. Keep most central area quiet. Clearly more character than the nearly smooth target, but balanced and soft.
